HME.mechanism_one_liner: 它解决的是缺失模态下的鲁棒 MSA（强调不依赖显式重建），核心机制是跨样本检索式 Hyper-Modality Enhancement + VIB + 不确定性融合，与 CMRP 的主要差异是：HME 用其他样本增强当前观测模态；CMRP 在同一样本内用 mask 条件编码 z，并用同网络 full↔miss 归一化一致性约束跨缺失模式稳定性。

hyper_modality_collision.HME_Hyper_Modality: cross-sample enriched modality prompts / enhanced Em,Fm fused with uncertainty
hyper_modality_collision.CMRP_z_hyper: same-sample Missing-Pattern-Aware encoder output z conditioned on (x',m); consistency on normalized z
hyper_modality_collision.verdict: NAME overlap only — dataflow NOT equivalent

HME.adaptation_cost: high (Baidu data; Acc/F1→MAE adapter; feature ≠ MultiBench)
HME.rerun_reason: Highest novelty-collision risk; must eventually be stress-tested under unified protocol. Not first smoke because Acc/F1-primary and Baidu data friction.

missing_protocol.all_missing: not the focus of main table
missing_protocol.mechanism_class: Teacher–Student KD (CAFD feature+correlation alignment + MAR difficulty weighting)

training_protocol.student_example: lr=2e-5; n_epochs=80; train_batch_size=128; begin_epoch=20; many KD hypers (tau,temperature,delta,gamma)

metrics.note: MOSEI regression converted for classification-style reporting in comparisons

reported_results.note: Acc/F1 by modality combo — METRIC_MISMATCH vs CMRP MAE/Corr primary

CMAD.mechanism_one_liner: 它解决的是缺失下 teacher–student 表示不一致与优化不稳定，核心机制是 CAFD（特征匹配+高阶相关对齐）与 MAR（按模态组合难度加权），与 CMRP 的主要差异是：CMAD 依赖完整模态教师网络蒸馏；CMRP 是同网络内 full/miss 视图上的归一化表征一致性，无双网络 KD。

kd_vs_same_net.verdict: narrative neighbors on 'consistency under missing'; mechanism NOT equivalent

CMAD.adaptation_cost: very_high (two-stage; Acc/F1; no official MOSI MSA script; Baidu teacher)
CMAD.rerun_reason: Best narrative neighbor for consistency story; too heavy and Acc-centric for first smoke.

features.dims_vs_CMRP: NOT MultiBench GloVe300; A/V dims coincidentally similar on MOSI (5/20) but text is BERT; sequences unaligned

missing_protocol.train: per-modality random missing_rate ~U(0,1), half samples forced 0; then TOKEN/FRAME-level erase (text→UNK=100; A/V zero frames)
missing_protocol.eval_test: missing_rate_eval_test applied uniformly to L/A/V at token/frame level
missing_protocol.dual_missing: not whole-modality dual dropout as CMRP primary; simultaneous partial erase on all modalities
missing_protocol.all_missing: r→1 would erase almost all tokens; paper skips r=1.0
missing_protocol.mask_explicit: missing_rate labels used in DMC completeness; not CMRP m-concat encoder

training_protocol.model_selection: IMPORTANT caveat: best ckpt selected separately per metric type (MAE vs Acc) — same-epoch fair compare needs re-run

reported_results.note: intra-token random avg — NOT CMRP Protocol-B whole-modality missAvg

LNLN.mechanism_one_liner: 它解决的是不完整数据下的鲁棒 MSA，核心机制是语言主导的 DMC 校正 + DMML 融合（并可选重建），与 CMRP 的主要差异是：LNLN 假设并强化语言主导完整性；CMRP 不以语言主导修复为目标，而是约束同一样本在不同缺失模式下的高层 z 稳定。

language_dominant_check.vs_CMRP: CMRP is non-language-dominant cross-missing representation stability

LNLN.adaptation_cost: medium (MAE/Corr native; MMSA data; missing protocol differs from Protocol B; metric-epoch caveat)
LNLN.rerun_reason: Best first actual re-run: MAE/Corr match CMRP primary metrics; single-stage; documented eval; lowest cost to stand up a baseline harness before novelty-critical HME.

final_tags.none_reported_only: All three have official code; none demoted to reported-only. None are low-priority for the paper story — CMAD is later wave by cost.

single_next_rerun.why_not_HME_first: HME is novelty-critical but Acc/F1-primary + Baidu aligned data + no MAE main table → poor first harness. Run HME after LNLN proves a baseline pipeline exists.
single_next_rerun.why_not_CMAD_first: Two-stage KD, Acc/F1, MOSEI-only MSA script, teacher ckpt friction — second/third wave.
single_next_rerun.why_LNLN_first: Native MAE/Corr; single-stage; MMSA path known; code already vendored locally; answers pipeline feasibility for fair verification without claiming SOTA.

stop: Phase-2 audit complete. No training started. Await explicit go for LNLN smoke / Path decision.
